findings.summary: Slider: VoiceOver announces a stale value when navigating with the VO cursor.
Base UI slider thumbs lack aria-label, so multi-thumb range sliders are unlabelled (gallery has a range slider). Workaround: pass aria-label per thumb.
Base UI Slider thumb has no visible keyboard focus across v4 styles. In the branch focus-visible was true on the hidden input; ring visibility not verified.
thumbAlignment=edge never re-measured after control resize; fixed in PR 6000. base-nova uses thumbAlignment=edge.
data-horizontal/data-vertical selectors vs data-[orientation]; no effect seen in the gallery.

notChecked: Only titles/summaries from GitHub search pages were read, not issue bodies
Reddit, Hacker News and blogs not searched

differences.reference: className goes on the Root element that also carries the flex/width classes, so className w-48 overrides w-full: sliders are 192px wide; vertical slider h-24 (96px).
differences.branch: base-nova puts className on an outer Root div with data-horizontal:w-full and the layout classes on an inner Control. w-48 loses to the data-horizontal:w-full variant: horizontal sliders measured 864px wide, stacked in rows; vertical slider measured 160px high (min-h-40 on Control) instead of 96px.
differences.how: Open /gallery#components, scroll to #slider, measure getBoundingClientRect of [data-slot=slider]: reference 192x4 (vertical h 96), branch 864x4 (vertical 4x160).

differences.reference: Thumb is a span role=slider with aria-valuenow/min/max; range thumbs have aria-label.
differences.branch: Thumb is a div containing a hidden input type=range; Root has role=group. Range thumbs get aria-valuetext 'start range'/'end range' and no aria-label. Screen-reader output differs (not run).

differences.reference: Root/Track/Range/Thumb are spans; data-radix-collection-item; no inputs.
differences.branch: Divs, extra Control wrapper, data-base-ui-slider-indicator, data-index, one input[type=range] per thumb.

apiChanges: Prop type becomes SliderPrimitive.Root.Props; onValueChange signature becomes (value, eventDetails). Gallery uses onValueChange={setRange}, which would still work. Not applied.
viewports: reference tab 500x701 (resize_window did not change the viewport); branch tab 1280x757
notes: Click thumb then ArrowRight x2, Home, End, PageDown gave 90 on both (keyboard matches). Not checked: 390x844 screenshots, drag, track click, disabled hover, vertical keyboard, reduced motion, focus ring pixels, touch.
reasonNotMoved: The base-nova slider moves className to an outer Root and keeps layout classes on an inner Control, so the gallery's w-48 and h-24 overrides no longer apply: sliders render 864px wide and the vertical one 160px tall instead of 192px and 96px. Accessibility structure also differs (role=group plus hidden input[type=range] per thumb; range thumbs lose aria-label), and open issues exist for VoiceOver stale values (https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/5296), missing multi-thumb labels (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/10221) and focus visibility (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12345). Retry when the registry file applies className to the element carrying the layout classes, and per-thumb labelling and focus-ring visibility are confirmed identical.
